_comment: Hand-authored. Bank 6 object handlers: far-call stubs, the formation spawner and a cell test ($99F1-$9A5B). The generators subtract these.

regions.name: TYPES $31 / $32 / $33 (pick-up box, its twin, shop item): handler
regions.description: A far call (inline `02 0E 80`) to bank 2 slot `$800F` (-> `$84CB`): the whole behaviour is in bank 2 (see the item objects).

regions.name: TYPE $34 (A MESSAGE): first frame and set-up
regions.description: Not yet initialised: `JSR $C0AE` (flags `$CA`, no hit points), `$0620,X` := `$0788,X` (the message number the creator left in `$0788`: the dialogue routine `$8471` indexes the pointer table by `$0620`) and `$0788,X` := 0.

regions.name: Type $34: every frame
regions.description: A far call (inline `02 08 80`) to bank 2 slot `$8009` (-> `$82C0`): the dialogue display state machine of bank 2 (also the gate banner). Created by the special screens with the message number in `$0788`.

regions.name: TYPE $35 (THE SPECIAL-SCREEN OBJECT): handler
regions.description: A far call (inline `05 11 80`) to bank 5 slot `$8012` (-> `$9F22`), described with the special-screen object.

regions.name: TYPE $29 (A FORMATION SPAWNER): first frame
regions.description: Not initialised: `JSR $C0AE` (flags `$DA`, no hit points), the countdown `$0698,X` := 1, `JSR $C0F0` (`$F9E9`: a random x, y = 8), y := 0. The spawn script's formation entry `[type|$80][count][interval]` (see the spawn-script entry) puts the type in `$0548`, the count in `$0560` and the interval in `$07A0`.

regions.name: Type $29: spawning allowed?
regions.description: `$60` bit 3 set (spawning stopped, e.g. by the boss) skips this frame.

regions.name: Type $29: spawn one
regions.description: The countdown is reloaded from `$07A0`; `JSR $C108` (`$FA5B`) finds the lowest free slot (none: skip this time); `$0548,X` is the child's type, `JSR $C105` (`$FA4B`) makes it at the spawner's position; `$0560,X` (the count) is decremented and at 0 the spawner removes itself.

regions.name: Is the cell under this object blocking? (`$9A53`)
regions.description: `JSR $8435` (the class under the object), `LDY $6C`, `LDA $8425,Y`, RTS: A non-zero when the class blocks the ship (classes 4-10 and 14). Used by the ground-bound enemies.
